svg.aria-label: One frame with spray: after Chapter 30's steps 1 to 9, the new SeaObjects::RecordSimulation fades the local foam into scratch, finds the water at the rock to write requests and atomic foam maxima, resolves the scratch to the sampled local foam, and runs Chapter 21's particle passes with emission sized by the requests. Step 10 then records the new rock into the sun's shadow cascades, each a rendering scope of its own, before its scene pass draws the sea, the new rock and the sky, and the new SeaObjects::RecordSpray draws the spray.
